title: Metric dictionary
description: Every reported number, defined exactly once. This is the accuracy lever, not paperwork.

definition.description: Precise enough that two staff who disagree can read it and find out who is right. 'Participants served' does not qualify.

source_of_truth.description: Exactly one source_id from the register.

extraction_labels.description: EXACT label strings that identify this metric in a source. No fuzzy matching, no stemming. 'Total participants' quietly binding to 'Total unique participants served' is how a real, cited, wrong number reaches a board. Two sources usually spell it differently, so adding a spelling is a visible diff someone reviews.

reconciliation_rule.description: Prefer halt_on_conflict. A discrepancy with an unresolved cause is a finding about the organization's operations, and quietly preferring one source hides the problem the engagement was hired to surface. Note there is deliberately no 'average' or 'prefer_newest' option.
